slideDifferences.nativeText:
Grammar
Examples
Observation
1
Preferences + Non finite clauses.
I need someone to build a life with. 

Any woman needs a good guy devoted to share her life.

Being ethical and committed, Paul wishes to get the same from his employees.
Non Finite clause are built from:

-Infinitive Clauses
-Ed Clauses.
-Ing Clauses
2
Preferences + Relative clauses.
Josh would love a company that can value his talent. 

Mary fancies a car where she can fit all her friends. 

I’m desperate for a partner who can meet my professional standards.
Relative clauses need to respect their principles even here.
Preference can have an extended meaning if we use the more complex grammar points to regular ones.

slideDifferences.nativeText:
To Consider 
1. Rather than is also another particle we use to build a non finite clause. E.G. Rather than leave the child alone, I brought him to work with me. 
2. We can also use small clauses. E.G. Her face all red with shame, she expressed what she wanted. 
3. We can also use It clauses. E.G. I love it when people are polite. 
*Verb must be in simple form.

slideDifferences.nativeText:
Preferences can be expressed in any tense and we the use of the correct clauses we can advocate the following functions.
Functions
Examples
1
State what people look for and want from others.
They’d love us to dance by their music during the training.
I expect committed classmates who make big efforts.
2
Express what you look for and want from things / situations
Striving through problems, the company desires the employees to stick by it.
Ashamed and disgusted, Jake wanted the problem to be over so he came clean.
To consider 
1. Clauses are not only used for this. We can use clauses in any other context as long as we are logical and coherent.

slideDifferences.nativeText:
B. Listen to the audio and answer the questions your teacher makes.
Have you gotten it yet?

One of the most difficult decisions in life is deciding who will accompany you for the rest of it. A lot of people dream of having the ideal match for life and striving through many experiences, they may get it. Most of us would love to share our life with someone kind, honest and  respectful, being these some of the good qualities we can mention. Getting very ugly, situations can get the worst from us, so it is natural that we expect to have a person who makes us come to our senses when necessary. However, happiness does not depend on having someone and we have to be clear on that. A happy life, you can create it on your own.
